description: F2P/P2P classification of this task's graded observations. F2P fail on the delivered state and pass after the reference repair; P2P pass on both. Measured in the task image, not derived from names. tests/grade.py reads this file and runs exactly the observations it names.

groups.requirement: RiemannianKMeans accepts backend-array centers or a callable receiving X and n_clusters. fit returns self, initializes nearest-center labels, alternates all-member cluster means with nearest updated-center labels, and stops when mean center displacement is below tol or max_iter updates occur. max_iter=0 retains initial centers and labels. predict uses nearest metric center for nonsingleton batches and multiple clusters. Cluster names are immaterial.

linear_mean and LinearMean.fit compute sum(weight * sample)/sum(weight), with equal weights when omitted and non-sample axes retained. FrechetMean selects LinearMean for Euclidean metrics, or explicitly with method=linear. fit returns self and sets estimate_.

RiemannianKMeans accepts backend-array centers or a callable receiving X and n_clusters. fit returns self, initializes nearest-center labels, alternates all-member cluster means with nearest updated-center labels, and stops when mean center displacement is below tol or max_iter updates occur. max_iter=0 retains initial centers and labels. predict uses nearest metric center for nonsingleton batches and multiple clusters. Cluster names are immaterial.
Prediction before fit raises RuntimeError.

linear_mean and LinearMean.fit compute sum(weight * sample)/sum(weight), with equal weights when omitted and non-sample axes retained. FrechetMean selects LinearMean for Euclidean metrics, or explicitly with method=linear. fit returns self and sets estimate_.
RiemannianKMedoids.fit returns self and clusters points around medoids chosen from the data.
OnlineKMeans.fit returns self with n_clusters centers on the manifold and labels.
KNearestNeighborsClassifier votes over the n_neighbors nearest points by manifold distance.
RiemannianMinimumDistanceToMean assigns each point to the class with the nearest Frechet mean.
KernelDensityEstimationClassifier classifies by radial-kernel density estimates per class.
The radial kernel functions return the documented kernel values of distance and bandwidth.
GeometricMedian.fit returns self and sets estimate_ to the Weiszfeld geometric median.
IncrementalFrechetMean moves 1/k of the way along the geodesic to each new point.
ToTangentSpace lifts points with log at the base point and inverse_transform maps back with exp.
RiemannianMeanShift finds n_clusters centers on the manifold and predicts the nearest center.
AgglomerativeHierarchicalClustering merges points by manifold distance into n_clusters clusters.
TangentPCA fits a PCA of the log-mapped data at the base point; transform/inverse_transform map between manifold and components.
FrechetMean on non-Euclidean spaces dispatches to the Frechet mean estimators and fit sets estimate_.
variance returns the (weighted) mean squared distance of the points to the base point.
FrechetMean on the circle uses CircleMean and returns the circular mean.
ExponentialBarycenter of Lie-group data returns self and sets estimate_, honouring weights.
pairwise_dists returns pairwise manifold distances; MDS embeds them in n_components Euclidean dimensions.
RiemannianEM fits a Gaussian mixture on the Poincare ball and exposes means_, variances_ and mixture weights.
LinearRegression on Euclidean inputs fits vector- or tensor-valued linear models.
GeodesicRegression fits intercept_ and coef_ of a geodesic model and predicts with exp.
WrappedGaussianProcess regresses manifold-valued targets around a prior with a wrapped GP.
KalmanFilter propagates and updates state and covariance for the documented localization model.
ScipyMinimize, ScipyRoot and NewtonMethod find the documented minimum and roots.
forward, centered and second centered differences follow their documented formulas.
The linear interpolators and the uniformly sampled path energy and path give the documented values.
GSIVPIntegrator, ScipySolveIVP and ExpODESolver integrate the initial value problem.
LogODESolver and LogShootingSolver solve the geodesic boundary value problem.
LogNormal dispatches by space and samples; BrownianMotion samples a path from the initial point.
The errors.check_* helpers raise the documented exceptions and accept valid input.
PGA on the hyperbolic plane dispatches to HyperbolicPlaneExactPGA and fits components.
AAC on graph space dispatches to the AAC estimator for the requested estimate.
The template estimator, classifier and transformer behave as their docstrings state.
FrechetMean selects SturmsMean, batch gradient descent and ElasticMean as documented and fits estimate_.
RiemannianKMeans accepts the 'random' and 'kmeans++' initializations and records init_cluster_centers_ and inertia_.
